subject: Davis R Users' Group schedule for Winter 2024

messages.author: 532359cb4f30370a
messages.subject: Davis R Users' Group schedule for Winter 2024
parts:
Hi D-RUGgies!

For winter 2024, the Davis R Users Group will have a new meeting time: 10-12 in the Datalab Classroom (360 Shields Library). Our first meeting of the quarter is TOMORROW, which will be a group work-session where you can come to work, get help with your R code, or just chat about R. As always, the meting will be hybrid in-person and remote over Zoom at https://ucdavis.zoom.us/j/92807937862

This quarter's schedule will feature fewer mini-workshops and more chances to ask our expeRts for help with your code and analyses.

Another way to get help with your R questions is to post your question any time to our Discourse Q+A forum at https://d-rug.discourse.group 

See you then,

Your D-RUG Coo[R]dinators 

________________________________________________________________
Please remember to post your questions to our Discourse site in advance of attending D-RUG virtually. This helps us do a better job of answering your questions, and also keep a log of the types of questions we see frequently.

For those not familiar with D-RUG, the R Users' Group is a weekly working group to get some help with R-specific coding problems. The coordinators are various and sundry coding connoisseurs, ranging from UCD data scientists to grad students on campus. We meet for 2 hours in an open-forum format, so you can treat D-RUG as a communal, co-working environment: come hang out and chat, work on your own, seek help, make friends. Or, a little bit of everything! Check out our website for more information.

-- 
Check out our R resources at https://d-rug.github.io/
And please post questions/comments at https://d-rug.discourse.group/
